activity.notes: Bashar al-Assad took the presidential oath on 17 July 2000 and remained president until his government collapsed and he fled Syria on 8 December 2024. ATLAS reuses the same formal Syrian Arab Republic polity used for Hafez al-Assad.

sources.title: SYRIA: BASHAR AL-ASSAD TAKES OATH AS PRESIDENT — Reuters Archive
sources.citation_text: Reuters' archive records Bashar al-Assad taking the presidential oath on 17 July 2000.

sources.title: Iron-fisted Assad never quelled Syrian rebels who came back to topple him — Reuters
sources.citation_text: Reuters reports Assad's overthrow and flight on 8 December 2024, ending his presidency.
